带图片的二维码。.en-us: A QR code with an embedded image.

通过设置`iconSize`调整二维码中图片的大小。.en-us: Use `iconSize` to set the size of the QR code's embedded image.

通过设置`bordered`显示或隐藏边框。.en-us: Use `bordered` to show or hide the border.

通过参数`status`控制二维码的状态。.en-us: Use `status` to set the QR code status.

通过参数`type`控制二维码的渲染类型。.en-us: Use `type` to choose the QR code renderer.

通过参数`color`和`bgColor`来控制二维码的颜色和背景色。.en-us: Use `color` and `bgColor` to set the QR code foreground and background colors.

通过设置`errorLevel`调整不同的容错等级。.en-us: Use `errorLevel` to set the QR code error correction level.

下载二维码的简单实现。.en-us: A simple way to download a QR code.

通过设置`autoSpin`控制在`value`处于回调更新中时，是否自动切换为.en-us: Use `autoSpin` to control whether updating `value` through a callback automatically enables the `loading` state.

监听当前“点击刷新”按钮累计点击次数，仅在`status`为`'expired'.en-us: Monitor cumulative refresh button clicks. Only applies when `status` is `'expired'`.
